description.en-US: Lyric file parsers for LRC, SRT and WebVTT. The app's lyric pane is powered entirely by this plugin — there is no built-in parser.
description.zh-CN: LRC、SRT、WebVTT 歌词文件解析器。应用的歌词显示完全由本插件驱动，应用内没有内置解析器。

description.en-US: OneDrive cloud storage provider (directory listing + byte-range download) implemented as a headless JS plugin.
description.zh-CN: OneDrive 云存储插件（目录列表 + 区间下载）。

description.en-US: Counts how many times each music has been played across Today, Yesterday, Last 3 Days, Last Week, Last Month, and Last Year.
description.zh-CN: 统计每首歌的播放次数，覆盖今天、昨天、最近 3 天、最近一周、最近一月和最近一年。

description.en-US: WebDAV cloud storage provider (directory listing + byte-range download, Basic/Digest auth) implemented as a headless JS plugin.
description.zh-CN: WebDAV 云存储插件（目录列表 + 区间下载，支持 Basic/Digest 认证）。
